access-assignment.title: Two paths to a seat
access-assignment.description: An enterprise chooses an available assignment path: directly assign eligible enterprise users or enable organizations to assign seats. Check the plan, policies and owner for the chosen path.

access-lifecycle.title: Maintain the seat lifecycle
access-lifecycle.description: Assign an eligible person, help them onboard, review membership and activity, investigate exceptions, and update the assignment when authorized. Other assignment paths may still apply.

policy-scope.title: Find the policy source
policy-scope.description: Start with the seat source. Organization-assigned and enterprise-assigned users can follow different defaults. Check effective policy and feature-specific conflict rules.

model-feature-baseline.title: Review availability before rollout
model-feature-baseline.description: Set separate defaults for features and models, decide whether to enable, disable or delegate each capability, then verify the effective experience and schedule review.

billing-ownership.title: One service, distinct financial questions
billing-ownership.description: A Copilot rollout raises separate seat and metered usage questions. Identify the financial owner for both, and distinguish spending authorization from a forecast.

consumption-controls.title: Find the actual limit
consumption-controls.description: Identify the applicable user-level budget, check included-usage and paid-usage conditions, then inspect applicable metered spending controls. A different budget cannot override a user-level hard stop.

budget-scenario.title: A blocked user with budget headroom
budget-scenario.description: In this hypothetical scenario, the user-level budget is exhausted even though the cost-center metered budget has headroom. The user-level hard stop still blocks credit-consuming work.

agent-operating-scope.title: Bound an agent rollout
agent-operating-scope.description: Choose a permitted audience and environment, review repository access and controls, then require appropriate review of the proposed changes.

agent-tools-network.title: Review separate execution paths
agent-tools-network.description: Agent work can use Bash-started processes and MCP servers. The firewall directly covers the former, not MCP processes. Review permissions and protections for each path.

instructions-context.title: Improve guidance through review
instructions-context.description: Select the audience and supported instruction scope, write task-relevant guidance, then evaluate outputs and update the guidance. Instructions are not permissions.

sensitive-content.title: Use complementary protections
sensitive-content.description: Sensitive content needs both access restrictions and supported content exclusions. Review connected tools and remaining limitations; exclusions are not a security boundary.

adoption-measurement.title: Interpret adoption in context
adoption-measurement.description: Define a question and denominator, select a complete reporting period and supported metric, then interpret trends alongside feedback and coverage limitations.

agent-activity.title: Choose evidence with care
agent-activity.description: An agent-activity question can use audit evidence or client telemetry, each with its own coverage. Review access, privacy and retention before collection.
